# Time Interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TimeInterval>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

A bounded stretch of time, optionally open-ended, delimited by a start and/or end instant.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:AbstractIndividual`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:AbstractIndividual`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
